rawFindings.title: Incorrect 'mountpath' assignment for mounted sub-applications
rawFindings.explanation: The line `mount_app.mountpath = path;` sets the mountpath of the sub-application to the 'path' argument, but 'path' may not always be a string representing the mount path, especially when called as `app.use(subapp)` where 'path' is the function (subapp) itself. The original code assigned `mount_app.mountpath = mount_path;`, ensuring it is always a string path (either the first argument if string, or '/' by default). This change breaks the mountpath assignment logic and can cause mount_app.mountp
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original assignment `mount_app.mountpath = mount_path;` to ensure the mountpath is always a string representing the mount point.
